- name: int_marketo__lead
      description: Lead dimension with merge/delete flags derived from activity tables; all leads from staging are retained (no filtering)
      grain: One row per input row in staging.stg_marketo__lead; duplicates on lead_id are preserved
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_marketo__lead
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead
      business_logic: '- Start with all rows from staging.stg_marketo__lead (no filtering or deduping in this model). - Build deleted_leads as the distinct set of lead_id from staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead. - Build unique_merges from staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads by: - Grouping by lead_id and concatenating distinct merged_lead_ids separated by ", ". - Null policy: null merged_lead_ids are ignored; if no non-null values exist for a lead, the result is null. - Ordering: no explicit ordering is applied during concatenation, so the sequence is not guaranteed. - Left join deleted_leads and unique_merges to the lead base on lead_id. - Compute flags: - is_deleted = TRUE if a matching deleted_leads.lead_id exists, else FALSE. - is_merged = TRUE if merged_into_lead_id is not null, else FALSE. - Select all original lead attributes unchanged (formatting preserved), plus is_deleted, merged_into_lead_id, and is_merged.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead identifier from staging; grain follows source and duplicates (if any) are preserved.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from staging; passed through unchanged
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from staging; passed through unchanged
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from staging; passed through unchanged
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creation timestamp from staging; passed through as VARCHAR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last updated timestamp from staging; passed through as VARCHAR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if lead_id appears in staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead, else FALSE (never NULL)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: merged_into_lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated distinct merged_lead_ids per lead_id; nulls excluded; order not guaranteed; null when no non-null values exist.
      - name: is_merged
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if merged_into_lead_id is not null, else FALSE (never NULL)
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: marketo__lead_intelligence_simple
      description: Simplified lead intelligence metrics and segments for non-deleted, non-merged leads with email engagement-derived scores and recommendations
      grain: One row per lead_id from intermediate.int_marketo__lead where NOT is_deleted AND NOT is_merged
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Build lead_base from intermediate.int_marketo__lead with lead_id, email, first_name, last_name, created_timestamp, updated_timestamp, filtering out deleted and merged leads. - Aggregate marts.marketo__email_sends by lead_id for records with a non-null lead_id: - total_emails_sent: count of all send records. - total_emails_opened: count of records flagged as opened. - total_emails_clicked: count of records flagged as clicked. - total_emails_bounced: count of records flagged as bounced. - total_unsubscribes: count of records flagged as unsubscribed. - unique_campaigns_participated: count of distinct non-null campaign_id. - first_email_sent_at: earliest activity_timestamp. - last_email_sent_at: latest activity_timestamp. - last_email_opened_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as opened. - last_email_clicked_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as clicked. - email_open_rate_pct: opens divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - email_click_rate_pct: clicks divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - total_lead_score: opens*5 plus clicks*10. - Derive segmentation per lead_id from the aggregated metrics: - rfm_segment by total_lead_score: Champion (>=100), Loyal Customer (>=50), Potential Loyalist (>=25), Regular Subscriber (>=10), At Risk (>=5), else Inactive. - value_tier by total_lead_score: Platinum (>=80), Gold (>=50), Silver (>=25), Bronze (>=10), else Basic. - lead_quality_tier by rates: A-Tier (open>=50 and click>=10), B-Tier (open>=30 and click>=5), C-Tier (open>=15), D-Tier (open>=5), else Unqualified. - Join lead_base to email_engagement and lead_segmentation with left joins on lead_id. - Default handling: - Counts, distincts, rates, and score are set to 0 if no engagement data is found. - rfm_segment defaults to "Unknown", value_tier to "Basic", and lead_quality_tier to "Unqualified" when segmentation is missing. - first/last timestamps remain null if the event never occurred. - days_since_last_* are the calendar days between the date of the last event and today; set to 9999 if the last event is missing. - lead_tenure_days is the calendar days between the lead''s created date and today. - lead_health_status (in order): Healthy if score>=50 and last open within 30 days; Good if score>=25 and within 60 days; Fair if score>=10 and within 90 days; Poor if score>=5; else Critical. - next_best_action (in order): Schedule Sales Call if click rate>=10 and last click within 7 days; Send Product Demo if open rate>=30; Re-engagement Campaign if last open is over 60 days ago and there has been at least one open; Welcome Series if there have been no opens; else Standard Campaign Flow. - last_updated_at is set to the current timestamp at query execution with time zone.'

      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique Marketo lead identifier; one output row per lead_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead email address from intermediate.int_marketo__lead
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead first name from intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead last name from intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - name: lead_created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of email sends for the lead; 0 if none

        - total_emails_sent >= 0
      - name: total_emails_opened
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as opened; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_emails_opened >= 0
      - name: total_emails_clicked
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as clicked; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_emails_clicked >= 0
      - name: total_emails_bounced
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as bounced; 0 if none
        tests:

      - name: total_unsubscribes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as unsubscribed; 0 if none
        tests:

      - name: unique_campaigns_participated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct non-null campaigns the lead participated in; 0 if none
        tests:
        - unique_campaigns_participated >= 0
      - name: email_open_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opens divided by sends times 100 rounded to two decimals; 0 when sends are 0
        tests:
        - email_open_rate_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: email_click_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks divided by sends times 100 rounded to two decimals; 0 when sends are 0
        tests:
        - email_click_rate_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: total_lead_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Engagement score computed as opens*5 plus clicks*10; 0 if no engagement
        tests:
        - total_lead_score >= 0
      - name: first_email_sent_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest email send timestamp; null if never sent
      - name: last_email_sent_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent email send timestamp; null if never sent
      - name: last_email_opened_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent open timestamp among send records flagged as opened; null if never opened
      - name: last_email_clicked_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent click timestamp among send records flagged as clicked; null if never clicked
      - name: days_since_last_email
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar days between the date of last_email_sent_at and today; 9999 if missing
        tests:
        - days_since_last_email >= 0
      - name: days_since_last_open

      - name: lead_tenure_days

        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: next_best_action

      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads

      - marts.marketo__email_sends

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique lead identifier from stg_marketo__lead; one row per lead_id.

        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: merged_into_lead_id

        description: Sum of per-send deliveries for the lead; missing values ignored; 0 when none.

        - not_null

- name: marketo__operational_health_simple
      description: Simplified marketing operations health snapshot with deliverability, lead, campaign, and stability metrics
      grain: Single-row snapshot at query time
      source_models:
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      - intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      business_logic: '- Build daily_email_volume from marts.marketo__email_sends where activity_timestamp is present, grouped by the calendar date of activity_timestamp: - Per-day counts: total emails sent, unique recipients, active campaigns, unique templates, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribes. - Daily rates as percentages rounded to 2 decimals: - daily_delivery_rate_pct = delivered / total * 100; if total = 0 then 0. - daily_open_rate_pct = opened / delivered * 100; if delivered = 0 then 0. - daily_bounce_rate_pct = bounced / total * 100; if total = 0 then 0. - Compute system_health_indicators over daily_email_volume: - system_volume_classification from the average daily_emails_sent: ≥1000 High Volume System; ≥500 Medium Volume System; ≥100 Low Volume System; else Minimal Volume System. - delivery_rate_volatility, open_rate_volatility, bounce_rate_volatility are the standard deviations of the corresponding daily percentage metrics. - delivery_stability from the standard deviation of daily_delivery_rate_pct: ≤5 Stable; ≤10 Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - days_of_data = number of daily rows; earliest_activity_date = minimum activity_date; latest_activity_date = maximum activity_date. - Compute deliverability_health across all marts.marketo__email_sends: - Totals: total_email_attempts (all sends), successful_deliveries (delivery true), total_bounces (bounce true). - overall_delivery_rate_pct = delivered / attempts * 100 (2 decimals); overall_bounce_rate_pct = bounces / attempts * 100 (2 decimals). - recent_delivery_rate_pct over the last 30 days: deliveries in last 30 days / total activity in last 30 days * 100 (2 decimals); if no activity in last 30 days then 0. - Compute campaign_health by first aggregating per non-null campaign_id in marts.marketo__email_sends: - Per-campaign averages: open rate = average of opened (as percent); bounce rate = average of bounced (as percent). - Summaries: total_campaigns = distinct campaign_ids; healthy_campaigns = distinct campaigns with open rate ≥25%; critical_campaigns = distinct campaigns with open rate <5%; campaigns_with_bounce_issues = distinct campaigns with bounce rate >10%. - Compute lead_database_health from intermediate.int_marketo__lead l left joined to marts.marketo__email_sends es on lead_id, filtering out deleted or merged leads: - Counts are over the joined rows (not distinct leads): engaged_leads = rows with a match and a click; moderately_engaged_leads = rows with a match and opened but not clicked; low_engaged_leads = rows with a match and not opened; inactive_leads = rows with no matching send; total_leads = total joined rows. - engaged_leads_pct = engaged_leads divided by total joined rows * 100 (2 decimals). - at_risk_leads_pct = rows with no match or with delivery false divided by total joined rows * 100 (2 decimals). - avg_lead_score = average of (count_opens*5 + count_clicks*10) for matched rows, using 0 for no-activity leads; rounded to 2 decimals in the final output. - Final output produces a single-row snapshot with: - health_check_date and health_check_timestamp taken at query time. - deliverability_health_status from overall_delivery_rate_pct: ≥95 Excellent; ≥90 Good; ≥85 Fair; ≥80 Poor; else Critical. - lead_database_health_status from engaged_leads_pct and at_risk_leads_pct: ≥40% engaged and ≤20% at-risk = Excellent; ≥25% and ≤30% = Good; ≥15% and ≤40% = Fair; ≥5% = Poor; else Critical. - healthy_campaigns_pct = healthy_campaigns / total_campaigns * 100 (2 decimals); if total_campaigns = 0 then 0. - Recent 7-day trends as averages of daily_email_volume where activity_date is within the last 7 days; returns NULL if no such days exist. - Volatility metrics are rounded to 2 decimals. - overall_health_score is the sum of four point components based on thresholds (deliverability, engagement, campaign mix, stability); the sum is rounded and stored as an integer (range ~35–100). - primary_recommendation chosen in order: if overall_delivery_rate_pct < 85 then focus on deliverability; else if at_risk_leads_pct > 30 then re-engage leads; else if critical_campaigns > 3 then optimize campaigns; else if delivery_stability is High Variance then stabilize sending; otherwise continue current efforts.'
      columns:
      - name: health_check_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Current date at query time for this snapshot
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: health_check_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Current timestamp at query time for this snapshot
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: system_volume_classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Classification from average daily_emails_sent (≥1000 High, ≥500 Medium, ≥100 Low, else Minimal)
      - name: delivery_stability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stability based on standard deviation of daily_delivery_rate_pct (≤5 Stable, ≤10 Moderate Variance, else High Variance)
      - name: days_of_data
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of daily_email_volume rows included in analysis
      - name: earliest_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Minimum activity_date present in daily_email_volume
      - name: latest_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Maximum activity_date present in daily_email_volume
      - name: total_email_attempts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total email send records counted across all time
      - name: successful_deliveries
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of sends where delivery was true
      - name: total_bounces
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of sends where bounce was true
      - name: overall_delivery_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Delivered divided by attempts times 100, rounded to 2 decimals over all sends
      - name: overall_bounce_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Bounces divided by attempts times 100, rounded to 2 decimals over all sends
      - name: recent_delivery_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Deliveries divided by total activity in the last 30 days times 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if no activity
      - name: deliverability_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status from overall_delivery_rate_pct thresholds (≥95 Excellent, ≥90 Good, ≥85 Fair, ≥80 Poor, else Critical)
      - name: total_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total joined row count after excluding deleted or merged leads
      - name: engaged_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count with a matched lead and a click
      - name: moderately_engaged_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count with a matched lead and opened but not clicked
      - name: low_engaged_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count with a matched lead and not opened
      - name: inactive_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count where no matching email_sends row exists
      - name: engaged_leads_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Engaged_leads divided by total joined rows times 100, rounded to 2 decimals

- name: int_netsuite2__balance_sheet
      description: Balance sheet presentation rows per transaction line and reporting period with account reclassification (Net Income/Retained Earnings/CTA), subsidiary details, and converted/unconverted amounts
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id × transaction_id × reporting accounting_period_id × derived presentation account (account_name + account_id/null)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts (driving transaction lines), keeping rows where the account is a balance sheet account or the driving row is flagged is_income_statement. - Left join: - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts by account_id to get account properties (is_balancesheet, type_name, is_leftside, general_rate_type, name, account_number). - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods twice: - reporting_accounting_periods via reporting_accounting_period_id (provides accounting_period_id, ending_at, name, is_adjustment, is_closed, fiscal_year_trunc, fiscal_calendar_id). - transaction_accounting_periods via transaction_accounting_period_id (used only to compare fiscal_year_trunc and fiscal_calendar_id with the reporting period). - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries by subsidiary_id and staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies via subsidiaries.currency_id to get the subsidiary currency symbol. - Create the main balance sheet row with presentation account reclassification: - If the account is not a balance sheet account and the reporting period’s fiscal year/calendar matches the transaction period → account_name/display/type_name/id are "Net Income"/"net_income". - Else if the account is not a balance sheet account → account_name/display/type_name/id are "Retained Earnings"/"retained_earnings". - Else → account_name/display come from accounts.name; for type_name: map lower(type_name)=''retearnings'' to "Retained Earnings", lower(type_name) in (''cta-e'',''cumultransadj'') to "Cumulative Translation Adjustment", otherwise use accounts.type_name; for account_type_id apply the same mappings to ''retained_earnings'' and ''cumulative_translation_adjustment'', otherwise use accounts.type_name. - account_id is null for non-balance-sheet rows; otherwise use accounts.account_id. - account_number is the Retained Earnings account_number selected from any account of type ''retearnings'' when non-balance-sheet; otherwise use accounts.account_number. - is_account_intercompany is always false. - is_account_leftside is false for non-balance-sheet; otherwise use accounts.is_leftside. - converted_amount: - Non-balance-sheet: use a negative sign; use transaction accounting period for historical/average rates, otherwise use reporting month. - Balance-sheet: for right-side (not is_leftside) use negative sign; choose transaction accounting period for historical/average rates, otherwise reporting month; for left-side use positive sign with the same rate selection. - Else → 0. - transaction_amount: - Non-balance-sheet → negative unconverted_amount. - Balance-sheet right-side → negative unconverted_amount; left-side → positive unconverted_amount. - Else → 0. - balance_sheet_sort_helper: - bank=1, acctrec=2, unbilledrec=3, othcurrasset=4, fixedasset=5, othasset=6, deferexpense=7, acctpay=8, credcard=9, othcurrliab=10, longtermliab=11, deferrevenue=12, equity=13, retained earnings=14, net income=15, CTA (''cta-e''/''cumultransadj'')=16; non-balance-sheet reclassification to Retained Earnings also =14; else null. - Union all a second row per included transaction line to represent Cumulative Translation Adjustment (CTA): - account_category=''Equity''; account_name/display/type_name=''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_type_id=''cumulative_translation_adjustment''; account_id=null; account_number selected from any account where lower(type_name)=''cumultransadj''. - is_account_intercompany=false; is_account_leftside=false. - converted_amount: use transaction accounting period for historical/average rates, otherwise reporting month (no sign flip). - transaction_amount: unconverted_amount. - balance_sheet_sort_helper=16. - Create balance_sheet_id by concatenating transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, account_name, and coalesced account_id using "_" as a delimiter and hashing the result with MD5 to produce a deterministic unique identifier.'
      columns:
      - name: balance_sheet_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic row id hashing transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, account_name, and coalesced account_id joined by '_'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier carried through from the driving transaction line
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction line identifier used in the surrogate key and as the row driver
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary id from the driving transaction line; used to join subsidiary attributes
      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from subsidiaries; null if no match
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name from subsidiaries; null if no match
      - name: subsidiary_currency_symbol
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary currency symbol resolved via subsidiaries.currency_id to currencies; null if no match
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting accounting period id from the reporting_accounting_periods join
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting accounting period end date from reporting_accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting accounting period name from reporting_accounting_periods
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Value from reporting_accounting_periods.is_adjustment; null if no match
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Value from reporting_accounting_periods.is_closed; null if no match
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category from the driving row; CTA union sets 'Equity'
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Presentation name: Net Income for non-balance-sheet with matching FY/calendar; Retained Earnings for other non-balance-sheet; otherwise accounts.name; CTA union sets ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Same as account_name for display
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Presentation type name with mappings: Net Income/Retained Earnings for non-balance-sheet; ''Retained Earnings'' for retearnings; ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'' for ''cta-e''/''cumultransadj''; else accounts.type_name'
      - name: account_type_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Presentation type id: ''net_income''/''retained_earnings'' for non-balance-sheet and retearnings; ''cumulative_translation_adjustment'' for CTA; else accounts.type_name'
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Null for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows; otherwise accounts.account_id
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Retained Earnings account_number when non-balance-sheet; CTA union uses a cumultransadj account_number; else accounts.account_number
      - name: is_account_intercompany
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Always false
      - name: is_account_leftside
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: False for non-balance-sheet and CTA union; otherwise accounts.is_leftside
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Converted amount with sign and rate selection: non-balance-sheet uses negative sign (transaction period for historical/average, else reporting month); balance-sheet uses is_leftside and general_rate_type to choose transaction vs reporting month and apply sign; else 0'
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Unconverted amount signed by side: non-balance-sheet and right-side balance-sheet negative; left-side balance-sheet positive; CTA union uses unconverted_amount'
      - name: balance_sheet_sort_helper
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Sort code by type and reclassification: bank=1, acctrec=2, unbilledrec=3, othcurrasset=4, fixedasset=5, othasset=6, deferexpense=7, acctpay=8, credcard=9, othcurrliab=10, longtermliab=11, deferrevenue=12, equity=13, retained earnings=14, net income=15, CTA=16; else null'

- name: int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics
      description: Comprehensive NetSuite data quality outputs combining an overall assessment with detailed per-table statistics and referential integrity checks
      grain: One row per report entry (overall assessment, table statistics, or integrity check)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entities
      business_logic: 'Compile intermediate checks and summarize into a final unioned report ordered by report_type and quality_grade (ascending): - source_table_stats (per source table snapshot with current time): - Transactions: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_id; counts of null transaction_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_date (null_dates), null entity_id (null_subsidiaries), null status (null_status); earliest_date = minimum transaction_date; latest_date = maximum transaction_date. - Transaction lines: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_line_id; counts of null transaction_line_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_id (null_foreign_keys), null entity_id twice for both null_accounts and null_amounts; earliest_transaction = minimum transaction_id; latest_transaction = maximum transaction_id. - Customers: total records; unique records by distinct customer_id; counts of null customer_id (null_primary_keys), null company_name (null_names), null email_address (null_emails), null date_first_order_at (null_creation_dates); unique_names = distinct company_name count; unique_emails = distinct email_address count. - referential_integrity_checks (three left-join checks; integrity percentages rounded to two decimals): - transaction_lines_to_transactions: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined transaction_ids; orphaned = base minus matched; integrity = matched/base × 100 (two decimals); timestamp = current time. - transaction_lines_to_entities: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - transactions_to_entities: base = transactions; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - business_rule_validations (four rules; compliance percentages rounded to two decimals; timestamp = current time): - transaction_id_uniqueness: violations = total transactions minus distinct transaction_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - customer_id_uniqueness: violations = total customers minus distinct customer_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - future_transaction_dates: violations = transactions with date more than one day in the future; compliance = transactions with date not more than one day in the future divided by total × 100. - balanced_journal_entries: sum netamount per transaction_id; violations = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount greater than 0.01; compliance = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount at most 0.01 divided by total × 100. - data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output. - overall_quality_summary (single row): - completeness_score = average across source_table_stats of: for transactions, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_subsidiaries) equals 0 else 70; for customers, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70; otherwise (e.g., transaction_lines) 85. - consistency_score = average integrity_percentage across referential_integrity_checks. - accuracy_score = average compliance_percentage across business_rule_validations. - assessment_timestamp = current time. - Final output (UNION ALL): - Overall row (report_type = ''Data Quality Assessment''): - overall_quality_score = average of completeness, consistency, and accuracy scores, rounded to two decimals. - quality_grade: Excellent (>= 95), Good (>= 85), Fair (>= 70), Poor (>= 50), otherwise Critical. - primary_concern: first applicable—Data Completeness Issues if completeness_score < 80; else Referential Integrity Issues if consistency_score < 80; else Business Rule Violations if accuracy_score < 80; else No Major Issues. - recommended_action: Immediate Data Cleansing Required if overall_quality_score < 70; Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended if < 85; otherwise Maintain Current Data Quality Standards. - tables_assessed = number of source_table_stats rows; integrity_checks_performed = number of referential_integrity_checks rows; business_rules_validated = number of business_rule_validations rows. - quality_assessment_id = MD5 of the assessment_timestamp as text. - Table Statistics rows (one per source_table_stats row; report_type = ''Table Statistics''): - quality_grade = table_name. - primary_concern = "Records: {total_records}, Unique: {unique_records}, Null PKs: {null_primary_keys}". - recommended_action: - Transactions: "Date Range: {earliest_date} to {latest_date}". - Transaction lines: "Date Range: {earliest_transaction} to {latest_transaction}" (transaction_id values). - Customers: "Date Range: {unique_names} to {unique_emails}" (distinct counts occupying those positions). - If any concatenated component is null, the whole string is null. - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of table_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Integrity Checks rows (one per referential_integrity_checks row; report_type = ''Integrity Checks''): - overall_quality_score = integrity_percentage (two decimals). - quality_grade = check_name. - primary_concern = "Matched: {matched}/{total}" using the matched join count over the base record count of the check. - recommended_action = "Orphaned Records: {orphaned_records}". - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of check_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Final ordering: by report_type then quality_grade ascending; casing and spacing in constructed strings are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: report_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row category: ''Data Quality Assessment'', ''Table Statistics'', or ''Integrity Checks'' (controls which metric columns are populated)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: completeness_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall completeness score from overall_quality_summary (unrounded average per rules); NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: consistency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall consistency score as average of referential integrity percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: accuracy_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall accuracy score as average of business rule compliance percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: overall_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Overall row: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals; Integrity rows: integrity percentage; Table Statistics: NULL'
      - name: quality_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall row: grade bucket (Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor/Critical); detail rows: table_name or check_name'
      - name: primary_concern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: dominant issue per precedence; Table Statistics: ''Records: X, Unique: Y, Null PKs: Z''; Integrity: ''Matched: matched/total'''
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: action by thresholds; Table Statistics: date range or positional counts; Integrity: ''Orphaned Records: N'''
      - name: tables_assessed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of source tables assessed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: integrity_checks_performed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of referential integrity checks performed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: business_rules_validated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of business rules validated (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp of the assessment or check snapshot based on current time
      - name: quality_assessment_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row-unique MD5 identifier seeded by report-specific fields and timestamp (overall: timestamp; table stats: table_name+timestamp; integrity: check_name+timestamp)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
        - unique

        case 
            when count(*) > 0

            else 0 
        end as compliance_percentage,
        'Customer IDs should be unique' as rule_description,
        TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-14 10:20:49.607+08' as check_timestamp
    from staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
    
    union all
    
    select 
        'future_transaction_dates' as rule_name,
        count(*) as total_transactions,
        count(case when transaction_date > DATE '2025-10-14' + interval '1 day' then 1 end) as rule_violations,
        case 
            when count(*) > 0 
            then round((count(case when transaction_date <= DATE '2025-10-14' + interval '1 day' then 1 end)::float / count(*)) * 100, 2)
            else 0 
        end as compliance_percentage,
        'Transaction dates should not be more than 1 day in the future' as rule_description,
        TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-14 10:20:49.607+08' as check_timestamp
    from staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
    
    union all
    
    select 
        'balanced_journal_entries' as rule_name,
        count(distinct transaction_id) as total_transactions,
        count(distinct case when abs(total_amount) > 0.01 then transaction_id end) as rule_violations,
        case 
            when count(distinct transaction_id) > 0 
            then round((count(distinct case when abs(total_amount) <= 0.01 then transaction_id end)::float / count(distinct transaction_id)) * 100, 2)

- name: int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      description: Liquidity, profitability, and efficiency metrics by subsidiary for the latest balance-sheet period with 12-month income aggregation
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id per accounting_period_id (latest accounting_period_ending only)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__balance_sheet
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__income_statement
      business_logic: '- From the balance sheet, keep only rows where accounting_period_ending equals the global maximum date; aggregate period_balance as the sum of converted_amount by subsidiary_id, account_type_name, accounting_period_id, and accounting_period_ending. - Current assets by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id (from period_balance): - total_current_assets: sum for account types Bank, AcctRec, UnbilledRec, OthCurrAsset (signed as stored). - cash_and_equivalents: sum for account type Bank. - accounts_receivable: sum for account types AcctRec and UnbilledRec. - Current liabilities by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id: - total_current_liabilities: sum of the absolute values of period_balance for account types AcctPay, CredCard, OthCurrLiab (non-negative total). - Equity by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id: - total_equity: sum for account types Equity, Retained Earnings, Net Income. - From the income statement, keep rows within the last 12 months from today and aggregate by subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum where account type is Income. - total_cogs: sum where account type is COGS. - net_income: sum where account type is one of Income, COGS, Expense, OthIncome, OthExpense. - Join logic: current_assets left join current_liabilities and total_equity on subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id; left join income_metrics on subsidiary_id only. - Ratios (no rounding; result is NULL when the denominator is NULL or <= 0): - current_ratio: total_current_assets divided by total_current_liabilities. - quick_ratio: (cash_and_equivalents + accounts_receivable) divided by total_current_liabilities. - cash_ratio: cash_and_equivalents divided by total_current_liabilities. - return_on_equity: net_income divided by total_equity (uses 12-month net income with latest-period equity). - gross_margin_ratio: (total_revenue − total_cogs) divided by total_revenue. - net_profit_margin: net_income divided by total_revenue. - receivables_turnover: total_revenue divided by accounts_receivable (uses period-end AR, not an average). - calculation_date is set to today’s date. - Scores (integers in {0,20,40,60,80,100};       grain: One row per transaction_id + transaction_line_id for income-statement transactions in their reporting period

      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies

- name: int_netsuite2__supplier_credit_monitoring
      description: Supplier credit monitoring and risk assessment per vendor-subsidiary derived from Netsuite transaction details and lines
      grain: One row per (vendor_id, subsidiary_id) where vendor_id is not null and total_expenses > 0
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: '1) Build vendor_transactions by joining transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Payable, AcctPay, Expense, OthExpense, Bank. - Derive vendor fields deterministically from entity_id: vendor_id = entity_id; vendor_name = "Vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email = "vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id + "@supplier.com"; vendor_creation_date is 730 days before the run date; vendor_relationship_days = 730. - Classify transaction_category: Payable for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; Expense for Expense or OthExpense; Payment for Bank; otherwise Other. - Set payment_status: Paid for Bank; Outstanding for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; otherwise Other. 2) Aggregate vendor_payment_behavior grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_creation_date, vendor_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_payables: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payable; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_payments: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payment; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Expense; NULL amounts do not contribute. - outstanding_balance: sum of absolute converted_amount for rows with payment_status Outstanding; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id across all grouped rows. - payment_transactions: count of rows classified as Payment where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows with payment_status Outstanding where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows with payment_status Outstanding. - last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows classified as Payment. 3) Compute vendor_risk_metrics: - payment_ratio: total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables is positive; otherwise 0. - avg_payment_delay_days: if there is at least one payment transaction, set to 15 plus a deterministic offset from 0 to 29 based on vendor_id, yielding 15–44; otherwise NULL. - relationship_duration_months: number of calendar months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; otherwise 1. - vendor_activity_status: Active if the last transaction is within 30 days of the run date; Recent if within 90; Dormant if within 180; otherwise Inactive; if last_transaction_date is NULL, treat as Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; if it does not exist, set to 0. 4) Compute vendor_credit_scoring: - payment_performance_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else. - payment_timeliness_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL delay yields 1. - relationship_stability_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else. - transaction_frequency_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else. 5) Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the four component scores. - credit_rating: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_balance exceeds 30% of total_expenses and days_since_last_outstanding >60; Medium Risk if exceeds 20% and >45; Low Risk if outstanding_balance >0 and >30; otherwise Minimal Risk (evaluated in this order). - recommended_credit_limit: total_expenses multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - monitoring_date: the run date. - supplier_monitoring_id: MD5 hash of vendor_id and subsidiary_id joined by an underscore. - Filter final rows to vendor_id present and total_expenses > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from transaction_lines.entity_id; not null; grouping key with subsidiary_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic name 'Vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id; deterministic per vendor_id

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic email 'vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id + '@supplier.com'; deterministic per vendor_id

        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp 730 days before the run date; constant per run

        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 730 representing relationship age in days
      - name: relationship_duration_months
        data_type: BIGINT

      - name: total_payments
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_expenses

      - name: outstanding_balance

      - name: total_transactions

      - name: payment_transactions

      - name: outstanding_transactions

- name: netsuite2_customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics derived from profitability (RFM-style), behavior patterns, retention scoring, and action recommendations
      grain: One row per customer_id (per build date = segmentation_date)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build a customer analytics view by combining profitability (cp), behavioral patterns (cbp), and retention (cr), then deriving insights and recommendations: - customer_behavior_patterns (cbp): - Join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t to staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines tl on transaction_line_id. - Filter rows: tl.entity_id IS NOT NULL, t.account_type_name = ''Income'', t.converted_amount > 0. - Aggregate by tl.entity_id (as customer_id) and t.subsidiary_id: - Transaction frequency: total_transactions = distinct transaction_id count; active_months = distinct calendar months; active_quarters = distinct calendar quarters. - Amounts (Income only): total_revenue = sum of positive amounts; avg_transaction_value = mean of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); transaction_value_volatility = sample standard deviation of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); max/min as per positive Income amounts. - Timing: first_transaction_date = earliest accounting period end; last_transaction_date = latest accounting period end; customer_lifespan_days = days between first and last transaction. - Seasonal counts: q1/q2/q3/q4_transactions = distinct transaction counts by calendar quarter. - Recency: days_since_last_transaction = days between last transaction and today. - analysis_date = today. - customer_retention (cr) from cbp: - retention_category by customer_lifespan_days thresholds: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New. - activity_status by days_since_last_transaction: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost. - avg_transactions_per_month = total_transactions divided by (customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months > 0 and customer_lifespan_days > 0; otherwise 0; no rounding. - retention_probability: 0.95 if days≤30 and total_transactions≥5; 0.80 if days≤60 and total_transactions≥3; 0.60 if days≤90 and total_transactions≥2; 0.30 if days≤180; 0.10 if days≤365; else 0.05. - Carry through total_transactions, total_revenue, avg_transaction_value, days_since_last_transaction. - enhanced_customer_segmentation (ecs) by left joining cp to cr on customer_id: - Carry cp.customer_name, customer_email, subsidiary_id, profitability_segment (cp.customer_segment), total_revenue, net_profit, transaction_count, customer_age_days; avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'

      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier sourced from cp (and cbp), filtered to NOT NULL in final output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from cp; propagated as-is without trimming or case normalization
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email from cp; propagated as-is without validation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from cp (behavioral CTE uses t.subsidiary_id but final value comes from cp)
      - name: profitability_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Revenue-based tier using overall percentile thresholds on cp.total_revenue: ≥P90 Platinum, ≥P70 Gold, ≥P50 Silver, ≥P30 Bronze, else Basic'
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage derived from customer_age_days, activity_status, retention_category, and cp.total_revenue vs cp average per defined precedence
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recency-based activity: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost based on days_since_last_transaction'
      - name: retention_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tenure-based retention: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New based on customer_lifespan_days'
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total revenue from cp; final rows require total_revenue > 0; units as defined in cp (no conversion here)
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net profit from cp; no additional adjustments applied
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total transaction count from cp; may differ from cbp total_transactions; no distinct logic applied here
      - name: avg_transactions_per_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average transactions per 30-day month from cbp: total_transactions/(customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months>0 and lifespan>0 else 0 (no rounding)'
      - name: comprehensive_customer_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score capped at 100 from weighted cp scores plus activity and retention bonuses per defined mapping
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Predicted retention probability from discrete thresholds: 0.95/0.80/0.60/0.30/0.10/0.05 per recency and total_transactions'
      - name: seasonal_preference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Quarter with highest distinct transaction count: ''Qx Peak'' with tie-breaker order Q1>Q2>Q3>Q4; else ''No Clear Pattern'''
      - name: transaction_consistency

      - name: growth_potential

      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation precedence: Win-Back Campaign, Retention Campaign, Onboarding Support, Upsell Opportunity, VIP Treatment, else Regular Engagement'
      - name: engagement_frequency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Suggested touch cadence: Platinum Weekly; Gold Bi-weekly; Silver Monthly; if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly'
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Days since customer creation from cp; integer day count
      - name: segmentation_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Build date set to current_date for all rows in the run
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_value_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sample standard deviation of positive Income converted_amounts per customer from cbp; NULL if insufficient data
      - name: q1_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT

      - name: customer_analytics_id

        description: Deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore
        tests:

      description: Executive financial dashboard aggregating ratios, cash flow, AR, customer metrics, trends, risk and benchmarks per subsidiary-period
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id present in intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__ar_aging_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      business_logic: '- Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; casing and spacing are preserved. - Result ordering: descending by total_risk_score, then descending by overall_financial_health_score.'

- name: netsuite2_operational_metrics
      description: Department/location monthly operational KPIs with trends, benchmarking, alerts, and recommendations derived from Netsuite transactions
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, performance_month; if multiple class_id exist for the same keys, rows are duplicated (class_id is part of the internal grouping but not exposed)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: '- Filter transactions to the last 24 months by accounting_period_ending. - Join transactions to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; left join departments, locations, and classes for display names. - Group by subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, class_id, the month start of accounting_period_ending (performance_month), and the quarter; compute: - department_revenue: sum of converted_amount where account type is Income; 0 if none. - department_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is COGS; non-negative. - department_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is Expense; non-negative. - transaction_count: count of distinct transaction_id. - revenue_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is Income. - expense_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is COGS or Expense. - unique_entities_involved: count of distinct tl.entity_id. - analysis_date: current_date. - Derive operational efficiency per grouped row: - revenue_to_expense_ratio: revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0; otherwise NULL. - gross_profit: revenue minus cogs. - gross_margin_percentage: (revenue minus cogs) divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - net_profit: revenue minus cogs minus expenses. - net_margin_percentage: net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - Additional intermediates (not selected later): average revenue per revenue transaction, average expense per expense transaction, and revenue per unique entity. - Compute trends per (subsidiary_id, department_id) using rows ordered by performance_month: - prev_month_revenue: value from the previous row in this order. - same_month_last_year_revenue: value from 12 rows prior in this order. - three_month_avg_revenue: average of the current row and the two immediately preceding rows (uses available rows when fewer than three). - three_month_avg_margin: same three-row window for gross_margin_percentage. - Note: because multiple location/class rows can exist for the same month, these windows operate over rows, not unique months; ties within a month use the engine’s row order. - Compute performance analysis: - month_over_month_growth: percentage change versus prev_month_revenue; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when prev_month_revenue <= 0 or missing. - year_over_year_growth: percentage change versus the revenue 12 rows prior; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing. - revenue_trend: ''Accelerating'' if revenue > 110% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 90%; ''Declining'' if > 80%; else ''Sharp Decline''. - margin_trend: ''Improving'' if margin > 105% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 95%; else ''Declining''. - performance_grade: ''Excellent'' when net margin >= 0.2 and ratio >= 2.0; ''Good'' when >= 0.1 and >= 1.5; ''Fair'' when >= 0.05 and >= 1.2; ''Poor'' when > 0; else ''Loss Making''. - Benchmark within each (subsidiary_id, performance_month): - revenue_rank_within_company: ranking by department_revenue descending; ties share rank with gaps. - margin_rank_within_company: ranking by net_margin_percentage descending; ties share rank with gaps. - revenue_vs_company_avg: revenue divided by the partition average revenue. - margin_vs_company_avg: net_margin_percentage minus the partition average net margin. - internal_market_share: revenue divided by the partition total revenue. - Alerts and recommendations (first matching condition applies): - alert_status: ''Revenue Decline Alert'' when year_over_year_growth < -20; else ''Loss Alert'' when net_margin_percentage < 0 and month_over_month_growth < -10; else ''Efficiency Alert'' when revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1.0; else ''Margin Alert'' when gross_margin_percentage < 0.1; else ''Normal''. NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts. - improvement_recommendation: ''Urgent restructuring required'' for ''Loss Making''; ''Review operations and cost structure'' for ''Poor'' with revenue_trend=''Declining''; ''Focus on cost optimization'' for margin_trend=''Declining'' with revenue_trend=''Stable''; ''Increase sales and marketing efforts'' for revenue_trend=''Declining'' with margin_trend=''Stable''; ''Scale successful practices'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent''; else ''Monitor performance closely''. - investment_recommendation: ''Increase Investment'' for ''Excellent'' with ''Accelerating'' revenue; ''Growth Investment'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent'' when internal_market_share < 0.3; ''Selective Investment'' for ''Fair'' with ''Improving'' margin; ''Review Investment'' for ''Poor'' or ''Loss Making''; else ''Maintain Current Investment''. - Final filter: keep only rows with performance_month in the last 12 months and non-NULL department_revenue. - Output order does not affect values: sort by subsidiary_id, performance_month descending, then department_revenue descending. - operational_metrics_id is an MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated; any NULL input yields NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Subsidiary identifier sourced from transactions; grouping key used for window partitions and benchmarking
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from transaction lines; may be NULL; used for grouping and window partitions
      - name: department_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department display name from the departments table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: location_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location identifier from transaction lines; included in grouping; may be NULL
      - name: location_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location display name from the locations table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Month start date from accounting_period_ending; only the last 12 months are kept in the final result
      - name: department_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for Income lines per group; sign preserved; 0 when no Income lines exist
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS where COGS is the sum of absolute amounts for COGS lines
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS minus Expenses where Expenses is the sum of absolute amounts for Expense lines
      - name: gross_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross margin ratio equals (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: net_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin ratio equals net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: revenue_to_expense_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0, otherwise NULL; unrounded
      - name: month_over_month_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the previous row’s revenue within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the previous value <= 0 or missing
      - name: year_over_year_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the revenue 12 rows prior within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing
      - name: three_month_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average over the current row and the two preceding rows ordered by performance_month; unrounded; may include duplicate months
      - name: revenue_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing revenue to the three-row moving average: Accelerating, Stable, Declining, or Sharp Decline'
      - name: margin_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing gross margin to the three-row moving average: Improving, Stable, or Declining'
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade based on net margin and revenue-to-expense ratio with defined thresholds: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, or Loss Making'
      - name: revenue_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by department_revenue descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: margin_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by net_margin_percentage descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: revenue_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition average revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: margin_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin minus the partition average net margin within (subsidiary_id, performance_month); unitless
      - name: internal_market_share
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition total revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: alert_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Alert based on ordered rules: Revenue Decline Alert, Loss Alert, Efficiency Alert, Margin Alert, else Normal; NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts'
      - name: improvement_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation derived from performance_grade and trend combinations; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Investment guidance based on performance_grade, revenue_trend, and internal_market_share; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: current_date at model run time; identical across all rows in a run
      - name: operational_metrics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated with underscores; NULL if any component is NULL; may repeat across locations or classes

      business_logic: 'Build one row per transaction_lines.transaction_line_id: - Start from transaction lines; inner join transactions by transaction_id; inner join subsidiaries by subsidiary_id from the line. - Left join: - Converted amounts on matching transaction_line_id and transaction_id, keeping rows where transaction_accounting_period_id equals reporting_accounting_period_id. - Accounts by line.account_id; and parent account by accounts.parent_id (treated as text). - Accounting periods by transactions.accounting_period_id. - Customers twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Classes by line.class_id; items by line.item_id; locations by line.location_id. - Vendors twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Vendor categories twice: from each joined vendor’s vendor_category_id. - Departments by line.department_id. - Currencies twice: transaction currency by transactions.currency_id; subsidiary currency by subsidiaries.currency_id. - Deterministic rules: - entity_id takes the line entity_id when present; otherwise the transaction entity_id. - is_transaction_non_posting is the opposite of line.is_posting; remains NULL when is_posting is NULL. - Accounting period fields come from the joined accounting period; transaction_due_date comes from transactions.due_date_at. - Account flags: - is_accounts_payable is true when account_type_name equals ''acctpay'' ignoring case; is_accounts_receivable is true when it equals ''acctrec'' ignoring case. - is_expense_account is true when account_type_name is one of ''expense'',''othexpense'',''deferexpense'' ignoring case; is_income_account is true when it is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case. - If account_type_name is NULL, these flags are NULL. - parent_account_id/name use the parent account when available; otherwise fall back to the current account id/name. - is_account_intercompany and is_eliminate are always false. - Customer fields (id/alt_name/company_name/city/state/zipcode/country/date_first_order/customer_external_id) are taken from the transaction-side customer when transaction_type is ''custinvc'' or ''custcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side customer. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Vendor fields (vendor_category_id/name, vendor_id/alt_name/vendor_name/vendor_create_date) are taken from the transaction-side vendor and its category when transaction_type is ''vendbill'' or ''vendcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side vendor and its category. If the converted amount row is missing, the value is NULL. - transaction_amount and transaction_line_amount follow the same sign inversion rule above, applied to line.amount and line.netamount respectively. If account_type_name is NULL, no inversion is applied. - transaction_details_id is the MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id concatenated with an underscore; inputs are treated as text; NULL when either input is NULL. - All rows from the joins are retained; NULLs from left joins are preserved; no explicit ordering is applied.'
